blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Historical archives are invaluable for multidisciplinary research but remain inaccessible globally due to severe language barriers. While manual translation is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, simply applying existing machine translation models is inadequate due to unique linguistic nuances and the temporal bias inherent in scarce human-labeled corpora. To address these challenges, we propose HERIT, a systematic domain-adaptation pipeline that leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to generate high-quality pseudo-labeled data from abundant Hanja-Korean corpora. This approach substantially expands the training dataset, mitigating both data scarcity and temporal overfitting across different historical periods. Extensive automated and human evaluations demonstrate that HERIT consistently outperforms baselines. Finally, we translate previously untranslated portions of the archives using our model, thereby enabling global access to these resources for researchers.
blocks.zh: 历史档案对于多学科研究来说是宝贵的,但由于语言障碍严重,在全球仍然无法查阅。 虽然人工翻译费用高昂而且费时,但仅仅应用现有的机器翻译模型是不够的,因为语言上有独特的细微差别,而且稀有的人类标本公司内在的时间偏差。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议使用HERIT这一系统化的域适应管道,利用回收加固的生成(RAG),从丰富的Hanja-韩氏体生成高质量的伪标签数据。 这种方法大大扩展了培训数据集,缓解了不同历史时期的数据稀缺和时间过渡。 广泛的自动化和人文评价表明,HERIT的业绩一贯高于基线。 最后,我们使用我们的模型翻译以前未翻译的部分档案,从而使研究人员能够在全球范围内利用这些资源。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Historical records have been a vital source for discovering knowledge and deriving insights. In the humanities, these archives allow researchers to analyze political dynamics and cultural evolution. In the natural sciences, they serve as crucial sources for tracking natural phenomena, such as solar eclipses, supernovae, and seismic activities.
blocks.zh: 历史记录一直是发现知识和产生见解的重要来源。 在人文学科,这些档案可以让研究人员分析政治动态和文化演变. 在自然科学中,它们成为跟踪日食,超新星等自然现象和地震活动的关键来源.

blocks.en: The Annals of the Joseon Dynasty ( AJD ) and the Journal of the Royal Secretariat ( JRS ) are regarded as preeminent historical archives, recognized not only in Korea but globally. They provide comprehensive records spanning over 500 years, comprising a vast array of subjects. Extending beyond state affairs and administration, they meticulously chronicle natural phenomena, including astronomical observations, seismic activity, famines, and epidemics. Accordingly, researchers worldwide utilize these archives across a broad spectrum of disciplines, from the social to the natural sciences.
blocks.zh: 朝鲜王朝的Annals (AJD)和"皇家秘书处杂志" (JRS)被视为卓越的历史档案,不仅在韩国,而且在全球都得到承认. 它们提供了长达500多年之久的全面记录,包括一系列广泛的课题。 它们超越了国家事务和行政范围,仔细记录自然现象,包括天文观测、地震活动、饥荒和流行病。 因此,世界各地的研究人员在从社会科学到自然科学等广泛的学科中利用这些档案。

blocks.en: Given their significance, the translation of the AJD from Hanja into Korean has been completed, while the translation of the JRS is currently underway. Furthermore, to promote the global accessibility of these historical archives, the National Institute of Korean History (NIKH) launched a project to translate the AJD into English. However, relying on manual translation by experts proficient in both Hanja and English presents significant challenges; the project is projected to span 22 years with a budget of approximately 20 million USD. 1 1 1 https://sillok.history.go.kr/eslk/about/translationProjectInfo.do Furthermore, applying this manual approach to other archives such as the JRS, which is five times more voluminous than the AJD, would require prohibitive costs in both time and resources. Consequently, existing human-translated English corpora are not only scarce but also heavily skewed towards specific reigns. Improving translation on unseen historical periods requires a method that generalizes beyond this temporal bias.
blocks.zh: 鉴于其重要性,已将《日本法律文件》从Hanja翻译成韩文的工作已经完成,而《日本刑法文件》目前正在翻译之中。 此外,为了促进这些历史档案在全球的取用,韩国国家历史研究所(NIKH)启动了一个将AJD翻译成英语的项目. 然而,依靠精通汉贾语和英语的专家的人工翻译提出了重大挑战;预计该项目将持续22年,预算约为2,000万美元。 1 1 1 https://sillok.history.go.kr/eslk/about/translationProjectInfo.do。 此外,对诸如联合档案局等其他档案采用这一人工方法,其篇幅是联合档案局的五倍,在时间和资源方面都需要高昂的费用。 因此,现有的由人翻译的英语公司不仅稀缺,而且严重偏向于特定的统治。 改进对不可见历史时期的翻译需要一种超越这种时间偏差的通俗化方法。

blocks.en: Since these archives are written in Hanja, leveraging Chinese-English LLMs appears to be an intuitive solution for processing these corpora. However, such an approach encounters significant challenges. First, there is a fundamental script mismatch: Chinese models typically utilize Simplified Chinese, whereas Korean Hanja retains Traditional Chinese forms, resulting in character incompatibility. Second, substantial semantic and syntactic discrepancies exist. Even when characters are identical, semantic divergence is common, as homographs have often evolved distinct meanings in the respective languages. Furthermore, the texts contain Korea-specific Hanja usage that reflects native grammatical structures, and the word order frequently deviates from standard Chinese syntax. Most critically, Chinese-English models transliterate proper nouns, such as personal names and geographical locations, based on Chinese pronunciation rather than Korean pronunciation. This misalignment not only degrades translation quality but also introduces factual errors.
blocks.zh: 由于这些档案都用汉字来写,利用中英的LLM似乎是一种直观的处理这些公司的方法. 然而,这种做法遇到了重大挑战。 首先,有一个基本的脚本不匹配: 中国模式一般采用简化汉字,而朝鲜汉字则保留了传统汉字形式,造成性格不相容. 第二,存在实质性的语义和同义差异. 即使字符相同,语义上的差异也是很常见的,因为同义体在相应的语言中经常演化出不同的含义. 此外,文中还包含了韩国特有的汉字用法,反映了本地语法结构,而单词顺序经常偏离了标准的汉字语法. 最关键的是,中英模式根据汉语发音而不是朝鲜语发音来转写适当的名词,如个人名和地理位置. 这种错位不仅会降低翻译质量,而且还会产生事实错误。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose a systematic domain-adaptation pipeline for training a Hanja-to-English model specialized for historical archives, harnessing human-translated corpora, as shown in Fig. 1 . To overcome the scarcity and temporal overfitting of available expert data, we introduce a retrieval-augmented in-context learning for data augmentation strategy that generates high-quality pseudo-labeled data. This effectively alleviates data sparsity while minimizing overfitting to specific eras. Subsequently, we present HERIT : a H anja- E nglish R AG-based I ntelligent T ranslation model for historical archives. Extensive evaluations, including quantitative metrics and human expert assessments, demonstrate that HERIT significantly outperforms existing baselines. In addition, we translate the remaining untranslated portions of the JRS and AJD using our model. Our model and the translated corpus are publicly available 2 2 2 https://github.com/dandamdandam/HERIT to facilitate future research.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立一个系统化的域适应管道,以培训一个专门处理历史档案的汉字对英文模型,利用图1所示的人类翻译公司。 为了克服现有专家数据的稀缺性和时间上的偏差,我们引入了数据扩充战略的检索强化文本学习,生成高质量的伪标签数据。 这有效地缓解了数据垃圾,同时将过度适应特定时代的程度降到了最低. 随后,我们介绍了HERIT:一个Hanja - E nglish R AG基于历史档案的一智能T批判模型. 广泛的评价,包括定量计量和人类专家评估,表明HERIT的绩效大大超过现有基线。 此外,我们使用我们的模型翻译了JRS和AJD的其余未翻译部分。 我们的模型和翻译本可公开查阅 2 2 2 https://github.com/dandamdandam/HERIT 为今后的研究提供便利。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Historical archives have extensively contributed to diverse research domains. In the field of social sciences, they provide foundational data for analyzing international affairs Thies (2002) , demography Alter (2019) , economic conditions Clark (2007) , and linguistic transitions Wei et al. (2025) . In parallel, the natural sciences leverage historical records to investigate natural phenomena such as astronomical events Wang et al. (2021) ; Wei and Yan (2024) and climate change Chen et al. (2020) ; Zhang et al. (2021) . Thus, historical documents serve as invaluable resources across diverse fields, offering a lens through which to understand past events and derive critical insights for both the present and the future.
blocks.zh: 历史档案对各种研究领域作出了广泛贡献。 在社会科学领域,它们为分析国际事务Thies(2002年),人口变化(2019年),经济状况Clark(2007年),和语言学转型的Wei等(2025年)提供了基础数据. 与此同时,自然科学利用历史记录来调查天文事件王等(2021年);魏和燕(2024年)和气候变化陈等(2020年);张等(2021年)等自然现象. 因此,历史文件是各领域的宝贵资源,为了解过去的事件提供了透视,并为当前和未来提供重要的见解。

blocks.en: Korean archives, such as AJD and JRS, are recognized as invaluable resources by the global academic community for their comprehensive scope, spanning multiple centuries and covering a wide array of subjects. Notably, the continuous and systematic management of these records makes them particularly advantageous for analyzing macroscopic changes. For instance, they have been extensively utilized in studies concerning astronomical observations and geological phenomena, as well as disasters such as epidemics, and even economic crises Stephenson (2011) ; Yang et al. (2012) ; Kim et al. (2017) ; Wang et al. (2021) ; Wei and Yan (2024) ; Rhee (2014) ; Hwang (2022) .
blocks.zh: 韩国的档案,如AJD和JRS,被全球学术界认为是具有广泛范围的宝贵资源,涵盖多个世纪,涵盖广泛的课题. 值得注意的是,这些记录的持续和系统的管理使它们特别有利于分析宏观变化。 例如,在天文学观测和地质现象以及流行病等灾害甚至经济危机(2011年)、杨等(2012年)、金等(2017年)、王等(2021年)、魏和燕(2024年)、瑞(2014年)、黄(2022年)的研究中,这些研究得到了广泛利用。

blocks.en: With advances in machine learning, such as OCR and machine translation, research has been conducted to effectively translate historical archives into modern languages. Afli and Way (2016) proposed a method to digitize historical documents written in 17th-century French using OCR and translate them into Modern English by applying stochastic machine translation techniques. To translate Ancient Chinese into Modern Chinese, Zhang et al. (2019) ; Liu et al. (2019) developed passage-level alignment methods and deep neural network-based machine translation models.
blocks.zh: 随着机能学习的进步,如OCR和机能翻译,研究有效地将历史档案翻译成了现代语言. Afli and Way (2016年)提出了使用OCR将用17世纪法语写成的历史文件数字化的方法,并运用斯多克特机器翻译技术将其翻译成现代英语. 将"古代汉语"翻译为"现代汉语","张等" (2019年);"刘等". (2019年)开发出通道级对接方法和以深神经网络为基础的机器翻译模型.

blocks.en: Among Korean historical documents, the AJD has been fully translated into Korean by the NIKH, whereas the translation of the JRS remains ongoing due to its vast volume. Addressing this, Kang et al. (2021) developed a Hanja-to-Korean translation model leveraging the parallel corpus derived from both the AJD and JRS. Concurrently, a project to translate the original Hanja text of the AJD into English is underway, with the records from the era of King Sejong (approximately 2.5% of the total) currently completed. Using this partial Hanja-English corpus alongside the Hanja-Korean data, Son et al. (2022) proposed a Hanja-Korean-English multilingual model. However, due to the scarcity of human-translated Hanja-English data, the performance of models trained from scratch remains limited.
blocks.zh: 在韩国历史文献中,日本国际法学会已完全翻译成韩文,而日本国际法学会的翻译由于数量庞大而仍在进行。 针对这一点,Kang等人(2021年)开发了汉字对韩的翻译模式,利用了来自日本国际法学会和日本遥感学会的平行文书。 同时,一个将AJD的正版汉字翻译成英文的项目正在进行之中,目前正在完成塞容国王时代的记录(约占总数的2.5%)。 Son等利用了这段部分汉字-英文正文与汉字-韩文数据并列. (2022)提出了汉字-韩-英语多语种模式. 然而,由于人文翻译汉字英语数据稀缺,从零开始训练的模型的性能仍然有限.

blocks.en: Recent LLMs, such as Gemini-2.5 Comanici et al. (2025) , Sonnet-4.5 Anthropic (2025) , Kimi-K2 Team et al. (2025) , GPT-5.1 OpenAI (2025) , and Qwen3 Yang et al. (2025) , have demonstrated remarkable in-context learning capabilities. This advancement enables them to utilize information during the inference phase via few-shot learning, even without having encountered it during the pretraining or fine-tuning stages Brown et al. (2020) . Specifically, RAG further improves performance by incorporating retrieved examples relevant to the input into the prompt Lewis et al. (2020) . Consequently, there is active research into data augmentation approaches for data-scarce domains that leverage these few-shot learning and RAG strategies Seo et al. (2024) ; Song et al. (2024) . Moreover, methods such as Best-of-N (BoN) Liu et al. (2024) and Fusion-of-N (FusioN) Khairi et al. (2025) have been proposed to further enhance performance by generating multiple candidate responses and aggregating them to derive a final answer.
blocks.zh: 近期的LLMs, 如双子座-2.5 Comenici等 (2025), Sonnet-4.5 Anthropic (2025), Kimi-K2 Team等 (2025),GPT-5.1 OpenAI (2025),和Qwen3 Yang等 (2025),展现出出众的内文学习能力. 这一进步使他们能够在推论阶段通过少发学习来利用信息,即使在预训或微调阶段Brown等人(2020年)没有遇到过信息。 具体来说,RAG通过将检索到的与投入相关的实例纳入即时Lewis等人(2020年),进一步提高了绩效。 因此,正在积极研究数据稀缺领域的数据增强方法,利用这些几发学习和RAG战略。 此外,Best-Of-N(BoN)Liu等人(2024年)和Fusion-of-N(FusioN)Khairi等人(2025年)等方法被提出来进一步提高绩效,产生多个候选人的回复,并汇总它们以得出最终答案.

blocks.en: We address the scarcity of historical parallel corpora by leveraging RAG-based augmentation. Specifically, we construct a high-quality pseudo-labeled dataset using Hanja-Korean corpora via retrieval-augmented in-context learning and FusioN. Finally, we fine-tune a pre-trained LLM, leveraging its inherent English proficiency and partial Hanja understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们利用基于RAG的扩充,解决历史平行公司稀缺的问题。 具体地说,我们通过检索-强化的内文学习和FusioN,用汉字-韩字corpora构建了高质量的伪标签数据集. 最后,我们微调了预先训练的LLM,利用其固有的英语熟练程度和部分汉字理解.

blocks.en: To prevent data leakage, we implemented a rigorous decontamination pipeline. Given that Hanja is an ideographic script where individual characters carry dense semantic information, character-level exact and edit-based matching is particularly effective. Specifically, for each test instance, we retrieved the top-10 candidate matches from D train D^{\text{train}} using BM25 and computed their character-level normalized Levenshtein similarity. We discarded any candidate exceeding a similarity threshold of 0.9 0.9 . We chose this threshold because historical archives frequently feature formalized administrative templates where changing a single entity or action drastically alters the translation semantics; lowering the threshold below 0.9 0.9 would excessively discard valid, semantically distinct evaluation instances. This pipeline filtered out 83 samples from D test D^{\text{test}} , 3 from D NT test D^{\text{test}}_{\text{NT}} , and 1 from the 200-sample human evaluation subset, leaving the evaluation splits well-isolated from D train D^{\text{train}} . Detailed examples and similarity distribution for the deduplication process are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 为防止数据泄漏,我们实施了严格的去污管. 鉴于汉嘉是个人人物携带密集语义信息的一款意识形态脚本,字符级精确和基于编辑的匹配特别有效. 具体来说,对于每个测试案例,我们用BM25从D^{\text{train}}号列车中检索出前十名的候选匹配者,并计算出其字符级的常态Levenshtein相似性. 我们抛弃了任何超过0.90.9的类似门槛的候选人。 我们之所以选择这一门槛,是因为历史档案往往有正式的行政模板,其中改变单一实体或行动会大大改变翻译语义;将门槛降低到0.9下将过度放弃有效、明显不同的评价实例。 这条输油管过滤出来自D测试 DQQText{test}的83个样本,来自D测试 NT测试 DQText{text{NT}的3个样本,以及来自200个样本的人类评价子集的1个样本,使得评价与D列车DQText{train}的分化很强. 附录A提供了分解过程的详细实例和相似性分布。

After filtering out documents longer than 800 characters, we constructed an augmented dataset, D aug D^{\text{aug}} , comprising 315K pseudo-labeled samples from all reigns except King Sejong’s. Finally, both D train D^{\text{train}} and D aug D^{\text{aug}} were utilized to train our model.

blocks.en: In addition, NIKH provides lexical resources, including semantic meanings and English pronunciations of proper nouns (e.g., personal and geographical names). Leveraging this data enables the LLM to comprehend Hanja documents more effectively and accurately translate proper nouns into English based on their correct pronunciation. Consequently, we compiled a glossary consisting of 25K entries from these lexicons and utilized it during the pseudo-labeling process.
blocks.zh: 此外,NIKH还提供词汇资源,包括语义意义和适当名词(如个人名和地名)的英文发音. 利用这些数据使LLM能够根据汉字的正确发音,更有效地和准确地将适当的名词翻译为英文. 因此,我们汇编了一个词汇表,由这些词汇中的25K个条目组成,并在假标签过程中加以使用。

blocks.en: 4 Proposed Methods
blocks.zh: 4 拟议方法

The framework comprises three main stages: 1) pseudo-labeling for data augmentation, 2) fine-tuning the LLM by integrating human-labeled and pseudo-labeled data, and 3) translation of the untranslated corpus using the trained model.

blocks.en: Since the pseudo-labeling process can incur substantial API costs due to the large volume of target historical documents, evaluating candidate LLMs in terms of both performance and cost-effectiveness is essential for selecting the optimal backbone. To this end, we first assessed the translation performance of various LLMs on D test D^{\text{test}} using base prompts. We employed standard metrics for machine translation, including BLEU Post (2018) , METEOR Banerjee and Lavie (2005) , and chrF++ Popović (2017) .

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , Hunyuan-MT-7B, despite being a leading Chinese translation model Zheng et al. (2025) , underperforms on Hanja translation. This result underscores the need for models specifically designed for Hanja. Results from the Qwen3 families demonstrate that translation quality generally improves as underlying model size increases. Regarding reasoning capabilities, while Gemini-2.5-Flash shows performance gains, Sonnet-4.5 experiences a slight decline. This aligns with prior surveys suggesting that reasoning does not significantly contribute to machine translation performance Zebaze et al. (2025) . A similar trend is observed with Gemini-2.5-Pro as shown in Table 4 . Although Gemini-2.5-Pro achieves the highest accuracy, it incurs higher inference costs due to its size and reasoning overhead. In contrast, Gemini-2.5-Flash offers the most cost-effective trade-off, achieving competitive performance at a fraction of the cost. Therefore, we adopt Gemini-2.5-Flash for the pseudo-labeling process.

blocks.en: 4.2 Building a Pseudo-label Dataset for Hanja-English Translation
blocks.zh: 4.2 为Hanja-英文翻译建立一个Pseudo-label数据集

blocks.en: To improve translation performance, we construct a high-quality pseudo-labeled dataset by adopting retrieval-augmented in-context learning and FusioN Khairi et al. (2025) approaches, following the process shown in Step 1 of Fig. 1 . Specifically, in Step 1-1, the Proposer takes untranslated source documents to generate multiple translation drafts. In Step 1-2, the Fusor takes these drafts along with the original source document to generate the final translation. Since this architecture generates the final sentence by ensembling the Proposer’s drafts in the Fusor, it not only mitigates mistranslation but also enhances translation quality by leveraging expanded information through a holistic examination of the drafts.
blocks.zh: 为提高翻译性能,我们采用FusioN Khairi等人(2025年)的方法,按照Fig步骤1所示的程序,采用检索强化的文本学习和FusioN Khairi等人(2025年)的方法,构建一个高质量的伪标签数据集。 1 (英语). 具体而言,在步骤1-1中,投标人取出未翻译的源文件来生成多份翻译草稿. 在"步骤一至二"中,富索尔将这些草稿同原始源文件一起取出以生成最终翻译. 由于这一架构通过在Fusor对投标人的草稿进行共鸣产生最后一句,它不仅减轻了翻译错误,而且通过对草稿进行整体审查来利用扩大的信息,提高了翻译质量。

blocks.en: As depicted in Fig. 1 , our goal is to improve the pseudo-label quality of the Proposer and Fusor by enriching the input prompt with auxiliary information, instead of relying solely on the Hanja document. To address the limited proficiency of LLMs in understanding Hanja, we augment the input with the corresponding Korean text to enhance contextual understanding. To ensure the accurate translation of proper nouns, we utilize a curated glossary by appending terms to the prompt when exact matches are found in the source text. We additionally utilize few-shot prompting to capture the nuances, including contextual and lexical information, of Hanja-to-English translation. Specifically, we adopt RAG that retrieves the top- K K similar documents 𝒮 ⁡ ( h ) \mathcal{S}(h) from D train D^{\text{train}} for a given input Hanja document h h via an embedding-based retriever. These retrieved entries are fed into both the Proposer and the Fusor as few-shot demonstrations in the form of (Hanja, Korean, English) triples.
blocks.zh: 如图1所描述的,我们的目标是通过用辅助信息来丰富输入提示器和福索尔的伪标签质量,而不是仅仅依靠汉字文件。 为解决法学硕士在理解Hanja方面的熟练程度有限问题,我们用相应的韩文增加了投入,以加强对背景的理解。 为确保准确翻译适当的名词,我们使用一个拼写词汇表,在源文本中找到确切的相配词时,将术语附加在提示上。 此外,我们还利用很少的镜头来捕捉汉贾语译为英文的细微差别,包括背景和词汇信息。 具体地说,我们采用 RAG,通过嵌入式检索器从DQQText{train}列车中取回顶端的 K K 类似文件 S (h)\ mathcal{S}(h) ,用于给定的输入 Hanja 文件 h h 。 这些检索到的条目被输入投标人和富索尔,作为以(汉字、韩文、英文)三相形式出现的少有镜头演示。

blocks.en: We optimized the hyperparameters for pseudo-labeling based on the experiments described in Section 5.1 . To balance performance and inference cost, we selected Gemini-2.5-Flash as the backbone for both the Proposer and Fusor, and employed Gemini-Embedding Lee et al. (2025) as the retriever. The retriever used the Korean component of the input document as the query for the Proposer, while utilizing both the input Hanja and the English translation drafts as the query for the Fusor. We employed 64 and 12 few-shot examples for the Proposer and the Fusor, respectively. During pseudo-labeling, the Fusor synthesized the final translation from five drafts generated by the Proposer with a temperature of 0.3.
blocks.zh: 基于第5.1节所述的实验,我们优化了伪标签的超参数。 为了平衡性能和推论成本,我们选择了双子座-2.5-Flash作为投标人和富索尔的骨干,并聘请双子座-Embedding Lee等人(2025年)作为取回者. 检索器使用输入文档中的韩文部分作为出价查询,同时使用输入汉字和英文翻译草稿作为出价查询. 我们分别为投标人和富索尔人提供了64个和12个几个例子。 在作伪标签时,富索从出价人出价为0.3的5个草稿中合成了最终翻译.

blocks.en: 4.3 Model Training and Translation of the Untranslated Corpus
blocks.zh: 4.3 未翻译公司示范培训和翻译

blocks.en: We present our model, a Hanja-to-English historical document translation model fine-tuned on Qwen3 32B. Our model performs end-to-end translation from Hanja to English. Our training utilizes two datasets: a pseudo-labeled dataset D aug D^{\text{aug}} and a human-translated dataset D train D^{\text{train}} . We employ a two-stage training strategy: the first stage uses D aug D^{\text{aug}} to learn Hanja semantics and phonetic patterns of proper nouns, while the second stage leverages D train D^{\text{train}} to align the model with human-level stylistic nuances. The entire training process was executed on eight H200 GPUs, taking 15.1 hours for the first stage and 1.2 hours for the second stage.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍我们的模型, 一个汉字对英文的历史文件翻译模型 在Quen3 32B上微调。 我们的模型执行端到端翻译 从汉嘉到英语。 我们的训练使用两个数据集:一个伪标签数据集D aug D^{\text{augh}};一个人口翻译数据集D^{\text{train}}。 我们采用两个阶段的训练策略:第一阶段使用 Dug D^{\text{aug}来学习汉字语义和普通名词的语音模式,第二阶段则利用 D  traintext{train} 来将模型与人文层次的语气细微相配合。 整个训练过程由8个H200GPU执行,第一阶段需要15.1小时,第二阶段需要1.2小时.

blocks.en: Finally, we deployed our model to translate all remaining untranslated AJD and JRS documents. Using eight NVIDIA H200 GPUs, the translation of these 2.09 million documents was completed in 94.6 hours, which is significantly faster and more cost effective than manual translation. To facilitate global accessibility to these historical records, both the dataset and the model are made publicly available.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们采用了我们的模型来翻译所有未翻译的AJD和JRS文件。 使用8个NVIDIA H200 GPU,这209万个文件的翻译工作在94.6小时内完成,比人工翻译要快得多,成本效益更高. 为了便利全球查阅这些历史记录,数据集和模型都公开提供。

blocks.en: To examine whether pseudo-labeling can eliminate the need for inference-time retrieval, we fine-tuned Qwen3-32B on D train D^{\text{train}} with a glossary and RAG applied during both training and inference. Although this configuration outperforms the D train D^{\text{train}} -only baseline, it still falls short of HERIT. More critically, retrieval augmentation incurs substantial computational overhead—expanding the context length to over 8K tokens (increasing the input prompt length by 13 to 14 times) and scaling training computational cost by 9 times. By contrast, HERIT effectively distills external knowledge directly into model parameters, achieving superior translation quality while remaining retrieval-free and highly efficient for large-scale historical text translation.
blocks.zh: 为了检查伪标签是否能消除推断时间检索的需要,我们在DQQText{train}的列车上微调了Qwen3-32B,在培训和推断期间都使用了词汇和RAG. 尽管这种配置的性能超过了D列车 DQQText{train} - 仅是基线,但仍然低于HERIT. 更为关键的是,检索增加会产生大量的计算间接费用——将上下文长度扩大到8K个以上符号(输入快取长度增加13至14倍),将培训计算成本缩放9倍。 相形之下,HERIT有效地将外部知识直接分解成模型参数,实现了较高的翻译质量,同时保持了检索自由并高效地进行大规模的历史文本翻译.

blocks.en: 5.3 LLM-Based and Human Evaluations
blocks.zh: 5.3 基于LLM和人类评价

blocks.en: Table 5: LLM-based evaluation on the testset D NT test D^{\text{test}}_{\text{NT}} .
blocks.zh: 表5:基于测试集D NT测试的LLM评价 D^{\text{test}}_{\text{NT}}.

blocks.en: Although D test D^{\text{test}} consists of human-translated data, it is restricted to specific reign periods, which limits generalization across the entire chronological scope of the AJD corpus. To address this, we performed an LLM-based evaluation on the held-out dataset D NT test D^{\text{test}}_{\text{NT}} by sampling 80 documents from each of the remaining reign periods excluded from pseudo-labeling. Adopting the method proposed by Zheng et al. (2023) , models first generate translations for D NT test D^{\text{test}}_{\text{NT}} . Subsequently, the LLM Evaluator assesses the translation quality score on a scale of 1 to 10, taking the source Hanja text and the model-generated English translation as inputs. To enhance the reliability of model-based evaluation, we provided the LLM Evaluator with the corresponding human-translated Korean text and glossary information as reference materials. We chose Sonnet-4.6 as the evaluator to avoid potential bias arising from the training process.
blocks.zh: 虽然D测试 DQQText{test}}由人翻译的数据组成,但它仅限于特定的统治时期,这限制了整个AJDaire的时间范围的一般化. 为了解决这个问题,我们对D NT 测试 D^{\text{ test}}_{\text{ NT}}}的被搁置数据集进行了基于LLM的评价,从被排除出伪标签的剩余统治期间的每一个文件中抽取出80个文件。 采用由郑等(2023)提出的方法,模型首先生成DNT测试 D^{\text{test}}_{\text{NT}}. 随后,LLM评价员以1到10的分数评价翻译质量分数,将源汉字和模型生成的英语翻译作为投入. 为提高基于模型的评价的可靠性,我们向LLM评价员提供了相应的由人翻译的朝鲜文文本和词汇资料作为参考材料. 我们选择了Sonnet-4.6作为评价者,以避免培训过程可能产生的偏见。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , the LLM-based evaluation demonstrates that for both the 8B and 32B models, the two-stage learning approach combining pseudo-labeled and human-translated data outperforms models trained exclusively on human-translated data. Notably, given that D NT test D^{\text{test}}_{\text{NT}} covers the entire AJD period disjoint from the training dataset, these results confirm the effectiveness of pseudo-labeling in enhancing generalization.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,基于LLM的评价表明,对于8B模型和32B模型,结合伪标签和人翻译数据的两阶段学习方法超过了专门接受人翻译数据培训的模式。 值得注意的是,鉴于D NT测试 D^{\text{test}}_{\text{NT}}}覆盖整个AJD时期与培训数据集脱节,这些结果证实了伪标签在增强通俗化方面的有效性.

blocks.en: Furthermore, while incorporating the glossary and RAG into both training and inference slightly improves performance over the baseline trained solely on D train D^{\text{train}} , the two-stage model trained on D aug D^{\text{aug}} substantially outperforms the model fine-tuned with the glossary and RAG. This highlights that pseudo-labeling provides significant additional performance gains, demonstrating that our approach effectively generalizes across the entire AJD period rather than temporal overfitting to the specific timeframe of D train D^{\text{train}} .
blocks.zh: 此外,将词汇表和RAG纳入培训和推论,比仅由DQText{train}列车培训的基线稍有改进,但Dug DXText{aug}}型的两阶段模式大大超过与词汇表和RAG进行微调的模式。 这凸显出伪标签提供了显著的额外性能收益,表明我们的方法有效地概括了整个AJD时期,而不是时间过长地适应了DQQText{train}的具体时间框架。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Human expert evaluation scores and preference ratios for our model versus the baseline.
blocks.zh: 图3:我们模型与基线的人类专家评价分数和偏好比率。

blocks.en: Additionally, using 200 examples sampled uniformly across different kings from D NT test D^{\text{test}}_{\text{NT}} , we recruited domain experts in Sinographic literature and Korean history who are proficient in English to evaluate our model against the baseline (Qwen3 32B trained solely on D train D^{\text{train}} ). We asked the experts to rate each translation on a scale of 1-5. Further, to differentiate between models in cases where scores were tied (excluding identical translations), we performed a comparative evaluation where experts were instructed to select the better response.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们利用来自D-NT测试的D-Text{test{text{NT}}}的200个不同国王的样本,招聘了精通英语的Sinograph文学和韩国历史领域的域专家,以根据基线评估我们的模型(Quen3 32B只通过D-Text{train}}号列车培训)。 我们请专家们按1-5的比例对每一译文进行评分。 此外,为了在评分挂钩(不包括相同的翻译)的情况下区分模型,我们进行了比较评价,指示专家选择更好的对策。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , our model achieved a score of 3.93, outperforming the baseline score of 3.22. In addition, HERIT achieved a selection rate of 66.84% in the pairwise preference evaluation, which is more than twice that of the baseline. These results demonstrate the superior translation quality of HERIT in human expert evaluation.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,我们的模型取得了3.93分的分数,超过了3.22分的基准分数。 此外,HERIT在对等偏好评价中实现了66.84%的选取率,是基准的两倍多. 这些结果显示HERIT在人类专家评价中的翻译质量较高.

blocks.en: 6 Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 分析

blocks.en: This section evaluates the model’s robustness against temporal overfitting and provides a qualitative analysis of translation examples.
blocks.zh: 本节评估了模型的稳健性,以适应时间的过度调整,并对翻译实例进行了定性分析。

blocks.en: 6.1 Temporal Overfitting
blocks.zh: 6.1 过度适应

blocks.en: Figure 4: Differences in human expert scores between HERIT (ours) and Qwen3 32B trained solely on human-labeled data, ordered chronologically by each king’s reign. Positive values indicate that HERIT outperforms the baseline, demonstrating its robustness across different historical periods.

blocks.en: To investigate whether our method effectively mitigates temporal overfitting, we analyzed the human evaluation results. Since the evaluation samples were stratified by king, as detailed in Section 5.3 , we computed the average score for each reign across both HERIT and the baseline, Qwen3 32B trained exclusively on human-labeled data. We then determined the performance gap between the two models for each reign and visualized these gaps chronologically.
blocks.zh: 为了调查我们的方法是否有效缓解时间过长的问题,我们分析了人的评价结果。 由于国王对评估样本进行了分级,如第5.3节所详述,我们计算了HERIT和基线中每个王位的平均得分,因此Quen3 32B只接受人类标记数据的培训。 然后,我们确定了每个统治时期两个模式之间的业绩差距,并按时间顺序对这些差距进行了目视。

blocks.en: As noted in Section 2 , the human-labeled corpus is heavily concentrated on documents from the reign of King Sejong. Consequently, Qwen3 trained on this temporally biased dataset performs comparably to HERIT during this specific period, as shown in Fig. 4 . In contrast, HERIT consistently achieves superior performance on documents from other reigns. This indicates that training on data concentrated in a single historical period leads to temporal overfitting, while the proposed pseudo-labeling strategy helps mitigate this bias and enhances overall translation robustness.
blocks.zh: 正如第2节所指出,人类标志书主要集中于世宗国王统治时期的文件。 因此,如图所示,在这一具体时期,接受过这一时间性偏差数据集培训的Qune3与HERIT具有可比性。 4 (韩语). 与此相反,HERIT在其它统治时期的文件方面一贯取得优异成绩. 这表明,集中在一个历史时期的数据培训导致时间上的过度适应,而拟议的伪标签战略有助于减少这种偏差并增强总体翻译稳健性。

blocks.en: 6.2 Qualitative Analysis of Translations
blocks.zh: 6.2 翻译的质量分析

blocks.zh: 表6:不同模型使用D测试 D^{\text{test}}}中的样本进行翻译的定性实例. 红色表示不正确的翻译,而蓝色表示正确的翻译。

blocks.en: We also conducted a qualitative comparison of HERIT against two baselines using samples from the test set: Qwen3 32B fine-tuned exclusively on human-translated data and Hunyuan-MT-7B, a leading Chinese translation model.
blocks.zh: 我们还利用试验集的样品对HERIT进行了定性比较:Quen3 32B完全根据人翻译的数据进行了微调,而Hunyuan-MT-7B是中国主要的翻译模型。

blocks.en: As shown in the first example in Table 6 , both Qwen3 32B and HERIT correctly transliterated the proper nouns according to Korean pronunciation rules, whereas Hunyuan-MT-7B incorrectly relied on Chinese phonetics. In the second case, the term 房子 carries distinct semantics depending on the context: it denotes a “house” in standard Chinese but refers to a “female palace servant” in the context of the Joseon Dynasty. While Hunyuan-MT-7B defaulted to the standard meaning and Qwen3 32B conflated the interpretations, HERIT identified the historical context and translated the term correctly. In the last example, Hunyuan-MT-7B failed to recognize the proper name 魚思漢, and neither baseline recognized the penal term 京外從便 (a form of punishment). In contrast, HERIT accurately translated these domain-specific terms.
blocks.zh: 如表6的第一例所示,Qwen3 32B和HERIT都按照韩语发音规则正确转写了适当的名词,而Hunyuan-MT-7B则错误地依赖了汉语口音. 在第二种情况下,xxy一词根据上下文而带有不同的语义:在标准汉语中指"住宅",但在朝鲜王朝中指"女宫侍从". 虽然Hunyuan-MT-7B默认了标准含义,而Quen3 32B对解释进行了拼接,但HERIT识别出历史上下文并正确翻译了术语. 在最后一个例子中,Hunyuan-MT-7B没有承认正名,也没有一个基线承认了刑事术语QQ(一种惩罚形式). 相形之下,HERIT准确地翻译出这些域特有名词.

blocks.en: These results demonstrate HERIT’s superior ability to deliver precise translations by capturing both Sino-Korean lexical nuances and the unique contexts of historical documents.
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示,HERIT通过捕捉中韩语法细微差别和历史文件的独特背景,具有提供准确翻译的优越能力。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this study, we presented HERIT, a systematic domain-adaptation pipeline designed to address the scarcity of parallel corpora in historical translation. By leveraging abundant intermediate resources through a RAG- and Fusion-based strategy, we developed a robust method for generating high-quality pseudo-labels without relying on costly human annotation. Extensive experiments, including both human and LLM-based evaluations, demonstrated that HERIT not only outperforms strong baselines but also effectively alleviates temporal overfitting, a persistent challenge in analyzing historical archives. Furthermore, our results highlight the potential of LLM-based data augmentation for other low-resource classical languages where direct translation pairs are limited. By enabling the translation of previously inaccessible documents, our work facilitates broader access to historical archives, empowering researchers worldwide to engage more deeply with historical texts.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们提出了HERIT,这是一个系统化的域适应管道,旨在解决历史翻译中平行的蝎子的稀缺问题. 通过基于RAG和Fusion的战略来利用丰富的中间资源,我们开发出一种强有力的方法,在不依赖昂贵的人类注释的情况下生成高质量的伪标签。 包括基于人类和LLM的评价在内的广泛实验表明,HERIT不仅超越了强有力的基线,而且有效地缓解了时间过长的问题,这是分析历史档案的一个长期挑战。 此外,我们的成果突出了基于LLM的数据对直接翻译对等的其他低资源古典语言进行扩展的潜力。 通过翻译以前无法获取的文件,我们的工作有助于更广泛地查阅历史档案,使世界各地的研究人员能够更深入地接触历史文本。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Due to budgetary constraints, we primarily employed Gemini-2.5-Flash for the Proposer and Fusor components, focusing exclusively on AJD documents for pseudo-labeling. We anticipate that employing a more diverse set of LLMs as Proposers to enhance translation diversity, as well as incorporating JRS documents as targets, would yield higher-quality pseudo-labels. Furthermore, hardware limitations necessitated restricting the maximum sequence length to 2,048 tokens, with a limit of 800 Hanja characters. Consequently, approximately 6.7% of the training data was filtered out. For inference, documents exceeding this limit were processed using a chunking strategy. We expect that extending the model’s maximum input length will further improve translation performance.
blocks.zh: 由于预算限制,我们主要使用双子双子2.5-Flash作为投标人和Fusor组件,只专注于AJD文件作假标签。 我们预计,使用一套更加多样化的有限责任公司作为投标人,以加强翻译的多样性,并将联合报告制度文件作为目标,将产生质量更高的假标签。 此外,硬件限制要求将最大序列长度限制在2 048个令牌上,限制为800个汉字. 因此,大约6.7%的培训数据被过滤出。 可以推论,超过这一限额的文件是采用分块策略处理的。 我们预计,延长该模型的最大输入长度将进一步改善翻译工作。

blocks.en: Fig. 6 illustrates the impact of the number of few-shot examples on the performance of both the Proposer and Fusor. Notably, the Proposer exhibits consistent performance gains up to 128 examples. However, to balance performance against the increased LLM inference costs incurred by larger shot sizes, we adopted a 64-shot configuration for the Proposer during pseudo-labeling. Additionally, we identified that a temperature of 0.3 and a draft count of 5 provided the best performance, and thus utilized these parameters for pseudo-labeling. In contrast, although the Fusor also improves with more examples, its marginal gains are less pronounced than those of the Proposer. blocks.en: We also evaluated the pseudo-labeling performance of multi-candidate aggregation methods, specifically FusioN and BoN. As shown in Table 8 , BoN outperforms the baseline, which generates translations in a single stage without candidate aggregation. However, FusioN demonstrates superior performance compared to BoN, suggesting that synthesizing a final output by aggregating all candidates is more effective than simply selecting the single best candidate.

blocks.en: In addition, we investigated the impact of proposer diversity on cost-effectiveness. The single-proposer setting relied solely on Gemini-2.5-Flash, whereas the diverse-proposer setting combined Qwen3 235B-A22B, DeepSeek-V3.1, GPT-5.1, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Sonnet 4.5. Table 9 reports the performance and cost of the single- and diverse-proposer settings, taking prompt caching into account. The results show that the single-model configuration achieves both better performance and higher cost efficiency. This suggests that while increasing model diversity yields a wider variety of candidates, it does not necessarily translate into better performance, making the single-model configuration a more cost-effective choice.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还调查了提议者多样性对成本效益的影响。 单提案设定完全依靠双子座-2.5-Flash,而多提案设定结合了Qune3 235B-A22B,DeepSeek-V3.1,GPT-5.1,双子座-2.5-Flash,和Sonnet 4.5. 表9汇报了单一和多样提议者设置的绩效和成本,同时考虑到快速缓存。 结果显示,单模式配置既能实现更好的性能,又能提高成本效率. 这表明,虽然模式多样性的不断增强产生更广泛的候选人,但不一定能转化为更好的业绩,使单一模式配置成为更具成本效益的选择。

blocks.en: To qualitatively verify that FusioN effectively synthesizes proposer-generated translations during the aggregation stage, we analyze the representative examples shown in Table 10 . In the first example, while candidate (2) misinterprets the syntactic structure, yielding a flawed translation, FusioN successfully adopts the correct phrasing from candidate (1), preserving semantic accuracy. In the second example, candidate (2) suffers from incomplete generation. FusioN effectively filters out this noise and consolidates valid information from the viable candidates to produce a fluent and comprehensive translation. In the third example, although multiple candidates generate the generic term “white falcon,” FusioN selects the historically accurate term “white goshawk” provided by a minority candidate, demonstrating its capability for fine-grained lexical selection. Overall, these cases illustrate that FusioN effectively aggregates candidate translations to ensure both factual correctness and grammatical fluency.
blocks.zh: 为了从质量上核实FusioN在汇总阶段有效综合了提议者产生的翻译,我们分析了表10所示的代表性例子。 在第一个例子中,虽然候选人(2)误解了综合结构,产生了有缺陷的翻译,但FusioN成功地采用了候选人(1)的正确措辞,保留了语义准确性. 在第二个例子中,候选人(2)的一代人不完整。 FusioN有效过滤出这种噪音,并整合了来自可行候选人的有效信息,以产生流利而全面的翻译. 在第三个例子中,虽然有多个候选人产生“白猎鹰”这一通称,但FusioN选择了一个少数群体候选人提供的历史上准确的“白鹰”一词,表明其精细的词汇选择能力。 总体而言,这些案件表明,FusioN有效地汇总了候选翻译,以确保事实正确性和语法流利性。

blocks.en: C.3 Translation Analysis for Proper Nouns
blocks.zh: C.3 适当名词的翻译分析

blocks.en: Table 11: LLM-based evaluation of proper noun accuracy across the baseline, pseudo-labeling, and training strategies.
blocks.zh: 表11:以LLM为基础的对基准、假标签和培训战略中适当名词准确性的评价。

blocks.en: To assess whether our proposed pseudo-labeling and two-stage training strategy effectively capture historical and factual context, we conducted an LLM-based evaluation. In particular, we examined whether the model correctly renders proper nouns using their actual Korean pronunciations rather than Chinese readings. Specifically, using Claude Sonnet-4.6, we evaluated the translation accuracy of proper nouns—including historical figures, geographical names, and official titles—in D test D^{\text{test}} . As shown in Table 11 , the proposed pseudo-labeling method substantially improves proper-noun translation accuracy over the baseline model trained only on D train D^{\text{train}} . Furthermore, the two-stage learning strategy provides additional gains beyond those achieved by pseudo-labeling alone.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们提议的伪标签和两阶段培训战略是否有效掌握历史和事实背景,我们进行了基于LLM的评估。 特别是,我们研究了该模型是否正确使用其实际的朝鲜语发音而不是汉语读音来制作适当的名词. 具体地说,我们使用克洛德·索内特-4.6,在D测试中评价了适当名词(包括历史数字、地名和官衔)的翻译准确性。 如表11所示,拟议的伪标记方法大大改进了仅由D-Q-text{ttrain-}列车培训的基准模型的正确名词翻译准确性。 此外,两个阶段的学习战略提供了额外收益,超出了仅通过假标签实现的收益。

blocks.en: Appendix D Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录D 人类评价

blocks.en: Figure 7: Web-based evaluation tool for human experts.
blocks.zh: 图7:人类专家网上评价工具。

blocks.en: To compare our model against the baseline, we recruited three professional experts in Sinographic literature and Korean history who are proficient in English to evaluate 200 items. The evaluation was conducted in a strict double-blind manner, ensuring that the evaluators remained completely unaware of the identity of the generating models. Prior to the task, the experts were provided with comprehensive instructions regarding the interface and the evaluation rubric.
blocks.zh: 为了将我们的模型与基线进行比较,我们征聘了三位精通英语的辛克文学和韩国历史专业专家来评价200件物品. 评价采用严格的双盲方式,确保评价人员仍然完全不知道生成模型的身份。 在任务之前,向专家提供了关于接口和评价主题的全面指示。

blocks.en: In addition, we developed a custom web-based interface to facilitate this evaluation, as shown in Fig. 7 . The interface displays the source Hanja text and the associated glossary at the top, while the anonymized outputs from both models are presented in the center. Evaluators rated each translation on a 1-5 Likert scale. To ensure a rigorous comparative analysis, a forced-choice mechanism was implemented; whenever a tie occurred (i.e., identical scores were given to both models), evaluators were required to select the superior translation based on three core criteria: • Semantic coherence : The degree of preservation of the original meaning without omission or distortion. • Terminological consistency : The correct and uniform translation of historical terms and proper nouns. • Naturalness : The fluency and readability of the translated English text.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们开发了一个基于定制的网络界面,以便利这一评价,如Fig所示. 7 (英语). 界面在上方显示源汉字文本和相关词汇,而两个模型的匿名输出则在中心显示. 评价员对每部翻译的评分为1至5等. 为确保进行严格的比较分析,实施了强迫选择机制;每当出现平分(即对两种模式给予相同的分数)时,评价人员必须根据三个核心标准选择优异的翻译: 语义一致性: 在不遗漏或歪曲的情况下保留原意的程度。 • 术语一致性: 正确统一地翻译历史名词和适当的名词. • 自然性: 英文译文的流利和可读性。

blocks.en: Semantic coherence : The degree of preservation of the original meaning without omission or distortion.
blocks.zh: 语义一致性: 保留原意的程度,不遗漏或歪曲.

blocks.en: Terminological consistency : The correct and uniform translation of historical terms and proper nouns.
blocks.zh: 术语一致性 : 正确统一地翻译历史名词和适当的名词.

blocks.en: Naturalness : The fluency and readability of the translated English text.
blocks.zh: 自然性质: 英文译文的流利和可读性。

blocks.en: Along with the quantitative scores, evaluators provided qualitative comments justifying their preferences or pointing out specific errors in the counterpart translations, including semantic distortion, information omission, terminology misuse, and unnatural phrasing.
blocks.zh: 除了定量分数外,评价人员还提供了定性评论,说明其偏好,或指出对应翻译中的具体错误,包括语义扭曲、信息遗漏、术语滥用和用词不自然等。

blocks.en: Fig. 8 shows the base prompt template used for direct Hanja-to-English translation in the baseline models discussed in Sections 4.1 and 5 . The system prompt defines the instructions for the translation task and provides a description of Hanja within the “Task” section. It also outlines “Guidelines for translation” and briefly explains the user prompt structure and expected output format. In the user prompt, the source Hanja text and relevant glossary information are provided in the “Input Document” section. For RAG-based baselines, relevant “Examples” are included as (Hanja, English) pairs.
blocks.zh: 图8显示了第4.1和5节所讨论基线模型中用于直接汉字对英文翻译的基准即时模板。 系统即时定义了翻译任务的指令,并在"任务"部分提供了汉字的描述. 报告还概述了“翻译准则”,并简要说明了用户的即时结构和预期产出格式。 在用户提示下,“输入文件”部分提供了源Hanja文本和相关词汇信息。 对于基于RAG的基线,相关的“实例”作为(汉字、英文)配对列入。

blocks.en: Similarly, Figs. 9 and 10 present the prompt structures used in the pseudo-labeling process described in Section 4.2 . Unlike the base prompt, the Proposer and Fusor prompts incorporate Korean translations provided by human experts, which serve as guidance for translating historical documents. The Fusor prompt largely follows the structure of the Proposer prompt, but differs in several key respects. Following the implementation of Khairi et al. (2025) , it includes a “Task” section describing the draft-fusion method and a “Fusion Steps” section outlining the procedure. In the user prompt, the task instructions and guidelines from the Proposer stage are included under “Translation Instruction,” while the drafts generated by the Proposer are listed under “Translation Candidates.” The Fusor leverages these translation candidates to generate the final translation.
blocks.zh: 类似地,Figs。 第9和10节介绍了第4.2节所描述的假标签过程所用的即时结构。 与基准快报不同的是,提案人和富索快报收录了由人类专家提供的韩文翻译,作为翻译历史文件的指导. Fusor 提示器大致遵循出价提示符的结构,但在若干关键方面有所不同. 在实施Khairi等人(2025年)之后,它包括一个“任务”部分,介绍浓缩法草案和一个“融合步骤”部分,概述程序。 在用户提示下,投标人阶段的任务指示和准则列在“翻译指示”下,而投标人生成的草稿列在“翻译候选人”下。 Fusor)利用这些翻译候选人生成最终翻译.
